title.zh: Two Entities Charged in $130 Million Fraud Scheme That Used False SEC Filings to Boost Investor Confidence
title.en: Two Entities Charged in $130 Million Fraud Scheme That Used False SEC Filings to Boost Investor Confidence

current_state.zh: The SEC charged BG Wealth Sharing Ltd and DSJ Exchange Pty Ltd, two foreign-operated but Colorado-incorporated entities, with orchestrating a $130 million fraud scheme that relied on false SEC filings to artificially boost investor confidence.
current_state.en: The SEC charged BG Wealth Sharing Ltd and DSJ Exchange Pty Ltd, two foreign-operated but Colorado-incorporated entities, with orchestrating a $130 million fraud scheme that relied on false SEC filings to artificially boost investor confidence.
